text: {"findings":[{"option_id":"c1.r1a1","rule_id":"container-apps-scale-to-zero-cold-start","reason":"The alternative sets min replicas to 2, so scale-to-zero cold start does not apply; however this entry is not flagged for that rule (no violation)."},{"option_id":"c1.r1a3","rule_id":"aks-free-tier-no-sla","reason":"The Free AKS tier has no financially backed uptime SLA for the API server, which is unsuitable for a production Web API serving 2,000 business users."},{"option_id":"c3.r1a1","rule_id":"sql-serverless-auto-pause","reason":"Serverless with auto-pause makes the first connection after an idle period wait up to about a minute to resume, which hurts a user-facing API at the start of the business day."},{"option_id":"c4.r1a3","rule_id":"redis-basic-no-sla","reason":"Redis Basic C0 is a single node with no replication and no SLA, meant only for development and testing, not a production cache."},{"option_id":"c4.r1a1","rule_id":"redis-premium-only-features","reason":"Today's P1 cache is Premium, and Standard lacks persistence, clustering and VNet injection, so replacing it is only valid if none of these are used; the details do not show they are needed, so this is not a violation."}]}
